localizedValues.description:
The oTENTik unit is a spacious blend of a tent and an A-frame cabin equipped with beds and furniture on a raised floor.
Interior: A double mattress and four single mattresses on three sleeping surfaces separated by curtains (see photo); a table that can accommodate up to 6 people and a storage cabinet containing all the equipment necessary for serving meals for 6 people (including plates, bowls, cups, glasses, wine cups, utensils, cutting board, bottle opener, kitchen tools, dishpan and dish soap); a rechargeable battery lantern, LED lighting and a USB port for recharging small electronic devices, both powered by solar energy; broom and dust cover. Please note: there is no electricity, plumbing or running water in the units.
Outside: Four camping chairs.
Other Services: Cooking shelter equipped with barbecues and side burner ( includes propane, cooking tools, pots and pans, strainer, can opener and coffee maker), a lounge area and picnic tables; sanitary facilities with toilets, showers and water supply with two sinks to wash the dishes. Bedding rental.
What to bring: Sleeping bags, blankets and pillows (bring extra blankets or warm sleeping bags for the cool September nights); food, beverages, reusable water containers and a cooler; clothing; towel; personal belongings and slippers or indoor shoes; flashlights; mosquito repellent.
What you should know: Accommodation units are located along a waterway that is not monitored. Children must be accompanied at all times. Swimming in the canal is prohibited; Accommodation units are located in an urban environment, therefore you can expect to hear the noise of the city off in the distance while you sleep; Pets are prohibited anywhere on the accommodation site; Parking fees are not included in the oTENTik rental, one parking space per unit rented is available on-site. Docking fees are not included in the oTENTik fees and dock space is available on a first-come

localizedValues.name: Stand-Up Paddleboard (SUP) Experience (10:30am start)
localizedValues.description:
This summer, try your hand at paddle sports at the Lachine Canal. Whether it's canoeing, kayaking, or stand-up paddleboarding, our certified instructors will accompany you throughout each activity, which includes a 30-minute theoretical session on the shore, followed by a 60-minute practical session in the canal. All necessary equipment is included
in the reservation.
